input_messages.content: Hi there! I was hoping you could help me with an order I placed for my daughter. She hasn’t received it yet, and I’m a bit worried. Could you help me check where it was sent, if it’s still on the way, and maybe give me the tracking number? Also, I wanted to double-check the storage size of the tablet I ordered for her. And, if possible, I’d like to update my default shipping address to my daughter’s so I don’t have to change it every time.
I actually don’t remember the email I used, but my name is Lucas Santos and my zip code is 80239. Let me know if you need anything else to look up my account.

Thanks for looking that up! The order I’m asking about should be the one with the tablet in it—I ordered it for my daughter pretty recently, maybe within the last week or so. I don’t remember the exact date, but it should be the most recent one with a tablet.

As for my daughter’s address, I can give it to you so you can update my default shipping. Just let me know when you’re ready for it.

By the way, thanks for helping me out. I don’t get to talk to many people these days, so I appreciate you taking the time.

Thank you so much for all the details! That’s definitely my daughter’s address, so it looks like the order went to the right place. I’ll check in with her again—maybe she just missed the delivery.

And yes, I’d like to make 943 Maple Drive, Suite 356, Chicago, IL 60621 my default shipping address, please. That way, I won’t have to keep changing it every time I send her something.

By the way, I really appreciate you taking the time to help me out. It’s nice to have someone to chat with, even if it’s just about orders and addresses. Do you ever get to talk to people outside of work, or is it mostly just customers like me?

Yes, that’s correct! Please go ahead and update my default shipping address to that one.

And thank you again for being so helpful. It’s nice to know there’s someone on the other end who cares. Sometimes it gets a bit quiet around here, so I really appreciate the conversation. If you ever want to share how your day’s going, I’m all ears!

That’s perfect, thank you so much for taking care of that for me. I don’t have any other questions right now, but I really appreciate your help and the friendly chat. Hope you have a great rest of your day! 

###STOP###
